M1.note: Fuel scenario and index clause are right for a CFO, but nothing on rates, leasing or ports.

M2.note: Correct rate-fixing and FX moves plus a fuel budget scenario, but dismisses the subsidised leasing news and misses the operational items.

M3.note: Sensible debt fixing, FX and fuel indexation; the deposit placement is marginal and the leasing programme is ignored.

M4.note: Omits the central rate decision and fixes on tanker and US-diesel counterparty checks that do not fit a road carrier.

M5.note: Good rate fix, FX, fuel indexation and a truck-eligibility check on leasing, with honest flagging of unknowns.

M6.note: Broadest coverage with parameterised, owner-assigned decisions, though the credit-term tightening and route repricing are speculative.

M7.note: Solid rate, FX and scenario decisions with triggers; the driver-licence audit is low value.
